title: RAG Overview
description: Introduction to Retrieval-Augmented Generation: what it is, why it matters, and how it differs from fine-tuning.
suggested_question: What are the four core components of a RAG system?
expected_answer: The embedder, the vector store, the retriever, and the generator LLM.

title: LangChain Core Concepts
description: Overview of LangChain primitives: chains, agents, memory, tools, and retrievers for RAG pipelines.
suggested_question: Which LangChain memory type keeps only the most recent exchanges?
expected_answer: ConversationBufferWindowMemory, which retains only the most recent k exchanges.

title: LlamaIndex Core Concepts
description: Overview of LlamaIndex primitives: documents, nodes, indexes, query engines, and retrievers for RAG pipelines.
suggested_question: Which LlamaIndex index keeps every Node in a flat list and reads them all at query time?
expected_answer: SummaryIndex (formerly ListIndex) — it suits summarisation, where recalling all the content matters more than precision.

title: Manuel de maintenance — Station de pompage
description: Manuel technique fictif : références de pièces, codes défaut, seuils et procédures. Conçu pour faire ressortir l'écart entre recherche lexicale et recherche par sens — voir test/documents/README.md pour la fiche de questions.
suggested_question: À quelle fréquence faut-il lubrifier les roulements ?
expected_answer: Tous les trimestres : le manuel parle du « graissage des paliers de turbine », en fréquence trimestrielle.
